analyst_view.overall: Early view: a relegation six-pointer between Samsunspor (17th) and Genclerbirligi (14th). Samsunspor finally won under Nenad Bjelica (1-0 against Konyaspor) but have conceded 26 and are missing Celil Yuksel with a grade 2 muscle injury; they visit Galatasaray the week before. Genclerbirligi's Diabate and Metehan Baltaci, listed as missing here, should have served their one-game bans against Gaziantep, so their status needs rechecking.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals and I lean slightly higher. Samsunspor have conceded 26 in eleven, including five at Basaksehir, and Genclerbirligi showed in their 5-0 against Alanyaspor that they can score in bunches, while their own defence has let in 21.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners. Samsunspor at home should do more of the attacking, and nothing in either side's recent games suggests the total is off.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards and I lean higher. Both clubs are fighting relegation, Samsunspor picked up three yellows in their win over Konyaspor, and Genclerbirligi had a man sent off and another banned for yellows in their last game before the break.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots. Samsunspor at home and Genclerbirligi on the counter should make for a fairly open game, which fits the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. With both defences leaky I would not go lower, but neither attack is reliable enough to push it clearly higher, so I stay near nine.
